title: Marrying in 1914; meeting his wife at St. Dominic Hall
summary: He married in March 1914 after meeting his wife at a dance; she liked music.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Did you see many musicians you knew in other towns? No, I didn't see any. You didn't try to play music in between or anything? You just come and go, huh? Just come and go is right. Well we want to get your wife in here. Did you fall in love with your wife and marry her because she was a musician or because you took care of?
No. I got married in 1914, on the 19th day of March. You know I used to play at the St. Dominic Hall. And that's where I met my wife. I met my wife at St. Dominic Hall.
Has she always been in sympathy with your music activities?
Well in fact she wasn't so much in the line of music but at the same time I suppose we just made up and got married. In other words if you liked music she liked
it, is that it? I suppose so. She liked music though. She seemed to like music. But she knew
I was making a living at it and so I suppose it was just that.
